description: PRD-38.2: Extended Widgets - Verify, complete, and harden the 5 Phase 2 widget types (Email, Terminal, Workflow, Memory, File). Components are scaffolded; this focuses on security hardening, missing dependencies, backend API endpoints, and integration.

userStories.title: Install missing Phase 2 widget dependencies

acceptanceCriteria: Verify dompurify and @types/dompurify are in frontend/package.json dependencies (install if missing)
Verify ansi-to-react is in frontend/package.json dependencies (install if missing)
Verify @tiptap/react and @tiptap/starter-kit are in frontend/package.json dependencies (install if missing)
Run pnpm install successfully with no peer dependency errors
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: dompurify, @types/dompurify, ansi-to-react already present. Installed @tiptap/react@3.20.0 and @tiptap/starter-kit@3.20.0. Fixed DOMPurify v3 type import in EmailViewer.tsx.

userStories.title: Harden EmailViewer with HTML sanitization
userStories.description: As a developer, I need email HTML content sanitized before rendering to prevent XSS from malicious emails.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/components/widgets/EmailWidget/EmailViewer.tsx, import DOMPurify
Implement sanitizeEmailHtml() with strict ALLOWED_TAGS: p, br, div, span, a, b, i, u, strong, em, h1-h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, pre, code, table, thead, tbody, tr, th, td, img
FORBID_TAGS includes: script, iframe, object, embed, form, input
FORBID_ATTR includes: onerror, onload, onclick, onmouseover
ALLOW_DATA_ATTR set to false
All bodyHtml passes through sanitizeEmailHtml() before rendering
Falls back to plain text body in a pre tag when bodyHtml is absent
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Sanitization was already implemented. Fixed plain text fallback to use <pre> tag instead of <div>. Removed unused variable.

userStories.title: Create backend API endpoints for widget email operations
